subject: VPC pricing: bespoke banding, platform fee bridging & SLA ask
content:
From: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@helixhealth.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Avery <tom.avery@helixhealth.ai>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood private deploy pricing — need a clearer path for year 1

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the demo last week. HelixHealth is excited about the VPC option — the performance numbers look strong. Before we move to procurement, I need a clear worksheet that shows: (1) platform fee amortization options for year 1 and 2, (2) an example support tier mix (standard vs. enterprise on-call) and costs, and (3) any one-time implementation or migration credits you can offer for a three-year commitment.

We’ve attached a one-page SOW and would like an itemized counter so our finance team can model it. Key constraints: we need a 99.9% SLA for inference latencies for production traffic and prefer to amortize platform fees over invoices rather than upfront capex. Also — can you do a limited pilot discount for Q3?

Appreciate a quick reply, we’re aiming to present to the budget committee on Jun 7.

Best,
Dana Ortiz
Director, Platform Partnerships
HelixHealth

Attachment: Helix_Initial_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

---
From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@helixhealth.ai>
Cc: Tom Avery <tom.avery@helixhealth.ai>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood private deploy pricing — need a clearer path for year 1

Hi Dana — great to hear Helix wants to move forward. I attached a quick scenarios workbook (PlatformFee_Scenarios.xlsx) but summarised the three recommended commercial paths below:

1) Consumption-first (low platform fee, metered nodes) — Year 1: 25% platform fee + metered nodes. Best if Helix prefers OPEX and avoids large upfronts. Includes Standard support (business hours).
2) Commit + amortize (recommended for predictable spend) — 12-month commit, platform fee amortized monthly across invoices (we can do finance-friendly monthly invoicing). Platform fee effectively reduced by 30% vs consumption-first for a 3-year term. Includes Enterprise support band + two on-call contacts.
3) Hybrid (pilot to commit) — Pilot (3 months) at 40% platform fee credit for pilot consumption; if commit to 24 months after pilot, we apply a one-time migration credit up to $75k and reduce platform fee to the commit band.

SLA note: 99.9% production inference latency is feasible on Dedicated capacity; on VPC we can commit to 99.5% latency SLA with automatic fallback routing and runbooks. For 99.9% we need a Dedicated or a high-availability multi-region VPC architecture (adds ~8–12% to platform fee).

I’ll loop in Neha (finance) and Ben (sales engineering) to scope implementation credits and finalize numbers.

Thanks — attaching the workbook.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Attachment: PlatformFee_Scenarios.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

---
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Helix pricing options and margin math

Maya — quick internal note before we send formal numbers to Dana:

- Baseline costs (expected infra + ops) for their projected Q4 peak is ~$220k/month.
- If we amortize platform fee over 36 months vs upfront, cashflow impact is +$360k revenue spread but we need to price so GAAP/finance OKs it. Recommend: commit-based pricing with 18–36 month amortization allowed but require a cancellation levy if they exit early.
- Support: Standard (included) vs Enterprise (+$18k/mo) vs Enterprise+Oncall (+$45k/mo). Oncall staffing cost is significant; limit enterprise on-call to two named contacts.
- Pilot credit proposal: offer 40% credit on platform fee for up to $60k of pilot consumption. If they convert to a 24-month commit within 90 days of pilot end, give a $75k migration credit.

Action: Ben, can you return a line-item quote (platform fee, commit discount tiers, support add-ons, cancellation levy) by EOD? Rishi — flag if 99.9% latency for VPC multi-region will require any additional engineering SOW.

Thanks,
Neha

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Helix pricing options and margin math

All — draft line items below (numbers rounded). I’ll format as a clean quote for Dana tomorrow morning.

- One-time migration engineering credit (conditional): $75,000 credit applied on first invoice if 24-month commit signed within 90 days of pilot end.
- Pilot period (3 months): platform fee at 40% credit; cap credit at $60,000.
- Commit bands (annualized):
  * 12-month commit: platform fee 18% (standard support incl.)
  * 24-month commit: platform fee 14% + $30k implementation credit
  * 36-month commit: platform fee 12% + $75k migration credit
- Support tiers: Standard (included), Enterprise +$18,000/month, Enterprise+Oncall +$45,000/month (two named contacts, 24/7).
- SLA: 99.5% for single-region VPC; 99.9% requires multi-region HA + warm standby (estimated +10% platform fee).
- Cancellation: early exit levy = remaining amortized platform fee balance * 0.6 (to disincentivize churn while sharing risk).

Flag: if finance will not accept amortized platform fee treatment in contracts, we’ll need a short memo from Neha to their procurement.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
From: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@helixhealth.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Avery <tom.avery@helixhealth.ai>, procurement@helixhealth.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood private deploy pricing — need a clearer path for year 1

Thanks for the fast turnaround, Maya/Ben/Neha. A few clarifying asks from procurement and finance:

1) Can you provide an example invoice schedule showing monthly amortization for a 24-month commit with the $75k migration credit applied? (finance needs to see P&L timing)
2) On the 99.9% SLA path — you’ve called out +10% platform fee for HA. Can you quantify operations uplift (additional runbook/monitoring engineering) vs pure infra cost? We need to see a delta breakdown.
3) Pilot discount: procurement wants the pilot credit to be applied as a direct invoice credit rather than an offset to consumption reporting. Is that acceptable?

We’re likely to prefer the 24-month commit if the amortization example preserves their monthly operating budget caps. Also, what would the onboarding timeline look like if we choose the hybrid pilot -> commit route?

Looking to finalize numbers by Monday morning so we can get to legal.

Best,
Dana

---
From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@helixhealth.ai>, Tom Avery <tom.avery@helixhealth.ai>, procurement@helixhealth.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood private deploy pricing — need a clearer path for year 1

Dana — thanks, great questions. Below are the concrete deliverables we’ll send by COB tomorrow (Thu Jun 4):

- Sample invoice schedule (monthly amortization) for 12/24/36-month commits with the migration credit applied to the first invoice. (Deliverable: PDF)
- Cost delta breakdown for 99.5% vs 99.9% latency SLA (infra vs ops uplift). We’ll show line-by-line: N+1 node cost, warm standby, ops FTE hours, and monitoring surcharge. (Deliverable: spreadsheet tab).
- Confirmation that pilot credit will be issued as a direct invoice credit on the first commercial invoice after pilot conversion. Procurement-friendly.
- Pilot -> commit timeline: 3-week pilot provisioning, 8-week pilot run (including integration + sample evals), then 2–4 week cutover (if commit). Total time to production ~14 weeks from pilot start.

Request to Helix: please confirm target peak Q4 throughput estimate (tokens/min or qps) so we can right-size nodes and produce accurate infra costs. Also confirm two names for enterprise on-call if you pursue that tier.

I’ll send the invoice schedule and the SLA delta breakdown tomorrow. If the budget committee meets Jun 7, we should be on track.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
